service.description: Whether the current user is a contact admin, who manages consent; with need, an error when not.

actions.script: isConsentAdmin = !!ec.user.userId && (ec.user.hasPermission('CONTACT_ADMIN') || ec.user.isInGroup('BOSS_CONTACT_ADMIN') || ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN')) if (need && !isConsentAdmin) ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('Only contact admins manage consent'))

service.description: The choices of the consent forms: the consent lists (not mailboxes; archived ones last and marked), the purposes, the sources and the statuses of the find (list statuses, then granted and withdrawn).

The registry (Comms/Consent): mantle.party.ConsentServices.find#Consents for a contact admin, each row with its texts for the list (the lists as chips, the purposes granted, the last change and its source); with exportCsv the CSV of every match instead.

parameter.name: changedThruDate
parameter.description: The end of the period, not in it

actions.script: consentList = [] consentListCount = 0 ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.ConsentServices.check#ConsentAdmin').parameter('need', true).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.ConsentServices.find#Consents').parameters({text: text || null, contactListId: contactListId || null, statusId: statusId || null, purposeEnumId: purposeEnumId || null, changedFromDate: changedFromDate || null, changedThruDate: changedThruDate || null, allowSolicitation: allowSolicitation || null, orderByField: orderByField || '-lastChangeDate', pageIndex: pageIndex || 0, pageSize: pageSize || 20, exportCsv: !!exportCsv}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return if (exportCsv) { csvText = out.csvText || ''; fileName = out.fileName || 'consents.csv'; return } const enumText = (id) => id ? (ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.Enumeration').condition('enumId', id).useCache(true).one()?.description ?? id) : '' const statusText = (id) => id ? (ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.StatusItem').condition('statusId', id).useCache(true).one()?.description ?? id) : '' const enc = (value) => String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"') const chip = (label, color, tooltip) => '' + enc(label) + (tooltip ? '' + enc(tooltip) + '' : '') + '' const listColor = (list) => list.subscribed ? 'text-positive' : list.statusId === 'CLPT_UNSUBS_PENDING' || list.statusId === 'CLPT_PENDING' ? 'text-warning' : 'text-grey-7' const flag = (value) => value === 'Y' ? L('Yes') : value === 'N' ? L('No') : '' consentList = Array.from(out.consentList || []).map((row) => Object.assign({}, row, { emailText: row.emailAddress || '', emailFlag: flag(row.emailAllowSolicitation), phoneText: row.phoneNumber || '', phoneFlag: flag(row.phoneAllowSolicitation), listsHtml: (row.listList || []).map((list) => chip(list.contactListName, listColor(list), statusText(list.statusId))).join('') || '—', purposesHtml: (row.grantedPurposeEnumIds || []).map((id) => chip(enumText(id), 'text-positive', L('Granted'))).join('') + (row.withdrawnPurposeEnumIds || []).map((id) => chip(enumText(id), 'text-negative', L('Withdrawn'))).join('') || '—', lastChangeText: row.lastChangeDate ? ec.l10n.format(row.lastChangeDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') : '', lastChangeDetail: [statusText(row.lastStatusId), enumText(row.lastPurposeEnumId), enumText(row.lastSourceEnumId)].filter((part) => part).join(' · ')})) consentListCount = out.consentListCount; consentListPageIndex = out.consentListPageIndex; consentListPageSize = out.consentListPageSize consentListPageMaxIndex = out.consentListPageMaxIndex; consentListPageRangeLow = out.consentListPageRangeLow consentListPageRangeHigh = out.consentListPageRangeHigh

service.description: One contact's consent for the screens: the party as the user may see it (check#ContactAccess), its addresses with their allowSolicitation and the current state of each purpose, its consent lists with the status, the purposes of the party as a whole, and, for a contact admin with includeHistory, a page of the history (get#PartyConsentHistory). canEdit is whether the user may change it (a contact admin). The choices of the forms: the lists the party may be added to, its addresses, the purposes and the sources.

actions.script: found = false; canEdit = false; addressList = []; listList = []; partyConsentList = []; historyList = []; historyListCount = 0 addListOptions = []; addressOptions = []; purposeOptions = []; sourceOptions = [] const access = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.ContactServices.check#ContactAccess').parameters({partyId: partyId, need: 'view'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return found = true partyName = ec.resource.expand('PartyFullNameTemplate', '', access.party).trim() || partyId canEdit = !!ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.ConsentServices.check#ConsentAdmin').call()?.isConsentAdmin const state = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.ConsentServices.get#PartyConsentState').parameters({partyId: partyId}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const enumText = (id) => id ? (ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.Enumeration').condition('enumId', id).useCache(true).one()?.description ?? id) : '' const statusText = (id) => id ? (ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.StatusItem').condition('statusId', id).useCache(true).one()?.description ?? id) : '' const when = (value) => value ? ec.l10n.format(value, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') : '' const enc = (value) => String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"') const chip = (label, color, tooltip) => '' + enc(label) + (tooltip ? '' + enc(tooltip) + '' : '') + '' const consentLabel = (consent) => enumText(consent.purposeEnumId) + ': ' + statusText(consent.statusId) const consentChips = (consents) => consents.map((consent) => chip(consentLabel(consent), consent.granted ? 'text-positive' : 'text-negative', [when(consent.consentDate), enumText(consent.sourceEnumId)].filter((part) => part).join(' · '))).join('') // the purposes that solicit through each kind of address const purposesOf = {CmtEmailAddress: ['PcpMarketingEmail'], CmtTelecomNumber: ['PcpSms', 'PcpPhone']} addressList = Array.from(state.addressList || []).map((address) => { const kind = address.contactMechTypeEnumId === 'CmtTelecomNumber' ? 'phone' : 'email' const purposes = purposesOf[address.contactMechTypeEnumId] || [] return {contactMechId: address.contactMechId, kind: kind, kindText: kind === 'phone' ? L('Phone') : L('Email'), addressText: address.addressText || address.contactMechId, isCurrent: !!address.isCurrent, allowSolicitation: address.allowSolicitation ?? null, allowText: address.allowSolicitation === 'Y' ? L('Allows contact') : address.allowSolicitation === 'N' ? L('Does not allow contact') : L('Not asked'), allowColor: address.allowSolicitation === 'Y' ? 'text-positive' : address.allowSolicitation === 'N' ? 'text-negative' : 'text-grey-7', consentHtml: consentChips(Array.from(address.consentList || [])) || '' + enc(L('No consent recorded')) + '', // the same consents as plain text, for the terminal and the standard page consentText: Array.from(address.consentList || []).map(consentLabel).join(' · ') || L('No consent recorded'), purposeEnumId: purposes[0] || null, purposeChoices: purposes.map((id) => ({key: id, text: enumText(id)}))} }) partyConsentList = Array.from(state.consentList || []).filter((consent) => !consent.contactMechId).map((consent) => ({purposeEnumId: consent.purposeEnumId, purposeText: enumText(consent.purposeEnumId), statusText: statusText(consent.statusId), granted: !!consent.granted, statusColor: consent.granted ? 'text-positive' : 'text-negative', whenText: when(consent.consentDate), sourceText: enumText(consent.sourceEnumId), evidenceText: consent.evidenceText || ''})) grantedText = Array.from(state.grantedPurposeEnumIds || []).map(enumText).join(', ') listList = Array.from(state.listList || []).map((list) => ({contactListId: list.contactListId, contactListName: list.contactListName || list.contactListId, typeText: enumText(list.contactListTypeEnumId), statusId: list.statusId, subscribed: !!list.subscribed, isCurrent: !!list.isCurrent, isArchived: !!list.isArchived, statusText: list.subscribed ? L('Subscribed') : (statusText(list.statusId) || L('Not subscribed')), statusColor: list.subscribed ? 'text-positive' : list.statusId === 'CLPT_UNSUBS_PENDING' || list.statusId === 'CLPT_PENDING' ? 'text-warning' : 'text-grey-7', canSubscribe: canEdit && !list.isArchived && !list.subscribed, canUnsubscribe: canEdit && list.isCurrent && list.statusId !== 'CLPT_UNSUBSCRIBED', sinceText: when(list.fromDate), lastChangeText: [when(list.lastChangeDate), enumText(list.lastSourceEnumId)].filter((part) => part).join(' · ')})) if (!canEdit) return const options = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.ConsentServices.get#ConsentOptions').call() const onIds = new Set(listList.map((list) => list.contactListId)) addListOptions = Array.from(options.listOptions || []).filter((option) => !option.archived && !onIds.has(option.key)) addressOptions = addressList.filter((address) => address.isCurrent).map((address) => ({key: address.contactMechId, text: address.addressText + ' · ' + address.kindText})) purposeOptions = Array.from(options.purposeOptions || []) sourceOptions = Array.from(options.sourceOptions || []) if (!includeHistory) return const history = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.ConsentServices.get#PartyConsentHistory').parameters({partyId: partyId, pageIndex: historyPageIndex || 0, pageSize: historyPageSize || 20}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return historyList = Array.from(history.historyList || []).map((row) => Object.assign({}, row, {whenText: when(row.consentDate), whatText: [row.purposeDescription, row.contactListName ? L('list') + ' ' + row.contactListName : null].filter((part) => part).join(' · '), statusColor: row.granted ? 'text-positive' : 'text-negative', byText: row.userName || L('the contact')})) historyListCount = history.historyListCount; historyListPageIndex = history.historyListPageIndex; historyListPageSize = history.historyListPageSize historyListPageMaxIndex = history.historyListPageMaxIndex; historyListPageRangeLow = history.historyListPageRangeLow historyListPageRangeHigh = history.historyListPageRangeHigh

service.description: Records a grant or withdrawal of consent with its evidence (mantle.party.ConsentServices.store#PartyConsent), by a contact admin, for a contact the user may see. A marketing purpose with no address goes on the party's primary address of its kind (marketing email on the primary email, SMS and phone on the primary phone) when it has one, so the address's allowSolicitation follows it. The source is PcsStaff unless given.

actions.script: ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.ConsentServices.check#ConsentAdmin').parameter('need', true).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.ContactServices.check#ContactAccess').parameters({partyId: partyId, need: 'view'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return let mechId = contactMechId || null const kinds = {PcpMarketingEmail: 'CmtEmailAddress', PcpSms: 'CmtTelecomNumber', PcpPhone: 'CmtTelecomNumber'} if (!mechId && kinds[purposeEnumId]) { const infos = Array.from(ec.entity.find('mantle.party.contact.PartyContactMechInfo').condition('partyId', partyId) .condition('contactMechTypeEnumId', kinds[purposeEnumId]).condition(ec.entity.conditionFactory.makeConditionDate('fromDate', 'thruDate', null)) .orderBy('fromDate').list()) const primary = infos.find((info) => ['EmailPrimary', 'PhonePrimary', 'PhoneMobile'].includes(info.contactMechPurposeId)) || infos[0] mechId = primary ? primary.contactMechId : null } const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.ConsentServices.store#PartyConsent').parameters({partyId: partyId, purposeEnumId: purposeEnumId, statusId: statusId, contactMechId: mechId, sourceEnumId: sourceEnumId || 'PcsStaff', consentDate: consentDate || null, evidenceText: evidenceText || null, comments: comments || null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return partyConsentId = out.partyConsentId allowSolicitation = out.allowSolicitation ?? null

service.description: Subscribes a contact to a consent list or unsubscribes it, by a contact admin with the note of where the request came from (mantle.party.ConsentServices subscribe#ContactListParty, unsubscribe#ContactListParty with confirmed: the admin records the contact's own request). Source PcsStaff.

The registry's bulk action: the selected contacts unsubscribed from a list by a contact admin (mantle.party.ConsentServices.unsubscribe#ContactListParties, confirmed, source PcsStaff, each on its own). A contact the user may not see is left out; one that fails is listed and the others are done.

A contact's whole consent history as CSV, for a data request (the person asks what was recorded about them), by a contact admin: when, purpose, granted or withdrawn, the address, the list, the source, the evidence, the comments and who recorded it, dates as ISO time stamps in UTC.
